content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Foreman Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Foreman (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Foreman (Mechanical) post at HBCHRC is scheduled for 15th September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any specific reporting times.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Foreman (Mechanical) position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is SSC along with a 2-year full-time ITI course in Mechanical from a government-recognized institute, plus 7 years of experience after ITI or 6 years after ITI plus NCTVT in mechanical maintenance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Foreman (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Foreman (Mechanical) post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Foreman (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Foreman (Mechanical) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Foreman (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Foreman (Mechanical) post at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Foreman (Mechanical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will involve an MCQ Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Foreman (Mechanical) post at HBCHRC.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre located?
faq.answer: The Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre is located in Mohali, Punjab, with the pincode 140901.
